name: claude-os
description: Build your own Claude OS: five guided builders that stand up a workspace for your business and build its skills for you. The main builder creates your folder, Front Desk router, memory, brand one-pager, and your two everyday skills (No AI Slop writing rules and Session Audit) to Save with one click; follow-up builders create your voice, ICP, design guidelines, and brand story, one per session.
